biotools.summary: RBAi is an agentic AI platform for life science research and bioinformatics, operated entirely through plain-language prompts with no coding required. Users can query 70+ biological databases and the biomedical literature and get answers with cited sources. It writes cited literature reviews and supports collaborative AI-assisted report and slide generation. It also runs bioinformatics computations such as molecular docking and energy minimization, and edits and renders protein structures. Users can install custom life science tools and connect files on their own computer to analyze and edit them by prompt. A command-line version, rbai-cli, is also available.
biotools.name: RBAi
